messages:
Raj (Partnerships): NimbleGrid just sent the final asset pack. Theyre asking for a brand usage exception: reduce logo clearspace in the mobile hero and allow a 56px lockup. PDF here: https://nimblegrid.example.com/assetpack.pdf. PR embargo 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Need design + brand + legal sign-off by EOD tomorrow. Thoughts? :eyes:

Jenn (Design): Looked through quickly — mobile mock looks packed. Our guideline min is 72px height for that lockup. 56px will feel cramped on smaller screens. Could we redesign the hero so logo sits to the left with extra padding instead of shrinking? :thinking:

Alex (PMM): From a PMM POV smaller logo might be okay if copy hierarchy stays intact. Users should still see the partner logo but not have it overpower Redwood. Could accept 64px as compromise if Brand is ok.

Marco (Brand): Prefer no exceptions unless partner provides a condensed lockup vector we can QA. If they cant provide, we need a written business rationale + a one-off exception doc logged in Brand Confluence. Exceptions team flags: visibility, co-mark placement, and consistency across channels. :no_entry_sign:

Sara (Legal): Quick checklist: 1) trademark attribution line required on partner case studies, 2) partner-signed brand usage agreement for the exception, 3) confirm no changes to partner-provided quote. Also confirm PR embargo window and partner contact for press. I can pre-approve conditional on signed doc.

asset-bot: Automated asset QC: nimblegrid_lockup.svg — clearspace fail. Measured clearspace = 32px; required >= 48px at recommended scale. File: s3://partners/nimblegrid/nimblegrid_lockup.svg

Mike (Ops): If brand signs off on a smaller variant, heads-up: we need to version the CDN asset with a new hash and purge cache post-publish. I can script the invalidation once design hands over the final files.

Jenn (Design): Quick mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/NimbleGrid-co-mark?node-id=234%3A56 — shows 64px + left-aligned layout option. Also added an alternate where we keep 72px but reduce eyebrow font-size.

Raj (Partnerships): Thanks — Marco / Sara can you confirm whether a 64px one-off is acceptable with conditions? Partner is pushing for tight hero for their brand teams look. Theyre willing to sign the usage exception doc.

Marco (Brand): I can accept 64px only if partner supplies a condensed vector and we add a margin overlay so the safe zone visually matches our baseline. Need the asset to pass automated QC. Please add the exception to Brand Confluence and tag me. :white_check_mark:

Sara (Legal): I will draft the one-page usage exception today. Condition: partner must include the trademark attribution exactly as below and sign it before PR. Copy to use:

"\u00A9 NimbleGrid Inc. 'NimbleGrid' is a registered trademark of NimbleGrid Inc., used with permission. All logos used per the NimbleGrid brand guidelines."

Sara (Legal): Also confirm embargo date and contact? Raj, loop in their PR lead so we can include contact details in the legal doc.

Raj (Partnerships): Looping in partner PR now. @Jenn (Design) can you push final 64px vector to s3 path and @Mike (Ops) can you prepare CDN invalidation script? If all green, I'll get partner to sign and we can schedule publish for 2026-04-06 09:05 PT. :thumbsup:

Jenn (Design): Uploading final vectors to s3 now: s3://partners/nimblegrid/final/v1/nimblegrid_lockup_64.svg. Included a note in Figma about safe-zone overlay.

asset-bot: Re-scan result: nimblegrid_lockup_64.svg — clearspace PASS, viewBox OK, recommended min-height flagged (64px one-off).

Mike (Ops): CDN invalidation script prepared, staging tested. Once legal confirms signature, I will push invalidation and tag the release.

Sara (Legal): Draft ready. Sending to Raj for partner signature. Condition: exception expires in 12 months and must be logged in Brand Confluence.

Raj (Partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. I'll get the signed doc and update the Confluence exception page. Tentative publish time booked for embargo lift +5 mins. :rocket:
